definitions.explanation: A word chosen to represent the content of a document so that it can be found in an index or search. Used in publishing, libraries, and information retrieval.

examples.japanese: {索引語|さくいんご}を{選|えら}ぶ。
{論文|ろんぶん}に{索引語|さくいんご}をつける。
examples.english: Attach index terms to a paper.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な{索引語|さくいんご}をつけると、{文献|ぶんけん}が{検索|けんさく}しやすくなる。
examples.english: Assigning appropriate index terms makes documents easier to search.

notes:
Combines {索引|さくいん} (index) with {語|ご} (word, term). A term used to index or retrieve a document, in publishing and information science.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {索引語|さくいんご}をつける: to assign index terms
- {索引語|さくいんご}の{選定|せんてい}: selection of index terms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- キーワード: keyword — the everyday, broader term
- {見出|みだ}し{語|ご}: headword — the word that heads a dictionary or index entry
